output.subject: We've received your complaint about payments to NATL WARRANTY DIRECT
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us. We have received your complaint, and we want to confirm what you told us.

You mentioned that a company called NATL WARRANTY DIRECT has been taking money from your checking account every two weeks since July. You told us you never signed up for anything with this company and that you have no idea how they got your account number. You have asked for these payments to be stopped and for all of the money taken to be returned to you.

We understand how worrying it is to see payments leaving your account that you don't recognize, and we're sorry for the stress this has caused.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days.

If you have any further details, such as the dates or amounts of the payments or any messages you may have received from this company, please reply to this message so they can be included in the review.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer reports the debits are ongoing every two weeks; decide whether to take or advise immediate action to stop further debits before the 10-business-day reply.
Confirm the dates, amounts and total of NATL WARRANTY DIRECT debits since July.
Customer requests the debits be stopped and a full refund; the outcome is for you to decide, and the draft does not promise either.
Customer says they don't know how the merchant got their account number; consider whether to discuss account security or a possible compromise with them.
Draft asks the customer to send any further details (dates, amounts, messages from the company); remove this if not wanted.
Confirm the customer's preferred contact method, as the complaint came via web form.
